original_target.title: List edge-colouring with no extra colours
original_target.area: Scheduling, resource allocation and graph colouring

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
queries: "list edge" "conjecture" proof site:zenodo.org OR site:hal.science OR site:github.com 2026

sources.scope: Prime-indexed complete graphs K_(p-1), K_(2p) and specified matching deletions, even in online form; not all multigraphs.

registry_checks: Palomar list-edge alias only routes to bipartite multigraph host completion using Galvin; no unrestricted claim. Hexagon/OpenAI full metadata checked. Focused arXiv, Zenodo, HAL and GitHub searches.
scope_comparison: Arbitrary loopless multigraphs and arbitrary edge lists of exactly chromatic-index size are required. Restricted complete/bipartite graphs and asymptotic multiplicative slack do not cover all inputs.
rationale: Bounded searches found no full matching resolution or announcement. September latest primary theorem remains a graph-family result.
